fields.statement: At 69611388, built rhiza to a scratch path and ran it in a scratch repo. `rhiza tui app autonomy --once` cmp-equals `rhiza daemon settings --json`. Ran the live app in a Rex window and drove it with rex send-key: enter on rhiza.daemon.paused set it true (source git config); enter on rhiza.autonomy.plan toggled owner->auto and back; editing maxRuns to 0 was refused inline ('must be a whole number of at least 1') with the entry kept open, then 5 saved; permissionMode edited as a word. d then n did nothing; d then y opened a Rex tab named 'rhiza daemon' and, with permissionMode acceptEdits, the header became 'Daemon running, process Mac.localdomain:79345'; d then y again sent TERM and the process was gone, header 'Daemon not running'. With permissionMode unset (the default) or 'default', d y still printed 'Started the daemon' while `rhiza daemon --autonomous` exited at once with a permission-mode error and its tab closed (reported as a finding). go test ./internal/tui/autonomyapp and TestScripts/(tui-autonomy-app|rex-install|describe-golden) pass.

At 69611388, with the built binary: `rhiza session key ZZZZ tab` refuses with 'want escape or enter' (exit 2); `rhiza session pane ZZZZ` says no session matches (exit 4); `rhiza describe session.key` documents escape/enter. Reading or pressing keys in a live agent pane was not run (driving a live session's terminal was not permitted in this QA session), so the pane/escape/message order rests on go test ./internal/tui/inboxapp (pass) and TestPaneUsageLimit (pass) plus reading the diff: n acts only on stalled items, calls session.pane, session.key escape when usage_limit, then session.message.
